desc: force orientation test for force-feedback devices
r: ffmvforce - force orientation test for force-feedback devices

ffmvforce generates a force in a given direction, indicated by the position of the mouse pointer in relation to the center of the tool's window.

Beware, the stress test may damage your device!

<device>
The device to test.
-u <update rate>
The update rate in Hz (5 by default).

ffmvforce was written by Oliver Hamann.

This manual page was written by Stephen Kitt <steve@sk2.org>, for the Debian GNU/Linux system (but may be used by others). It was last modified for ffmvforce dated February 15, 2002.
